name: Curtin Emergency Student Loan
summary: Loan of up to $2,000, repaid within six months, for Curtin students with a temporary, unexpected financial need.
key: Successful recipients may borrow up to $2000.
who: Enrolled in a Curtin award course within Australia
No outstanding debt to Curtin and a satisfactory academic record
Temporary, unexpected financial need with documents, and evidence you can repay
how: Contact the Scholarships Office (Building 102, Perth campus, 1300 222 888) and explain why you need the loan
catches: Repay within six months of approval under a signed loan agreement
Missed payments may incur a financial penalty
Not for tuition, study costs, existing commercial debt or recreation
